### God May Use Distress to Expand Your Influence
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-october-30-2020.html
Passage: 1 Chronicles 4:10
Points:
- Jabez demonstrated a bold desire for God to enlarge his territory and sphere of influence.
- Growth and expansion often come through distress and painful circumstances.
- When God stretches believers, His purpose is to fill them with more of Himself.
- Believers should not settle for small boundaries, but pray big prayers to a big God.

### What's in a Name?
Author: Sharon Jaynes
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-12-30-04-1301396.html
Passage: 1 Chronicles 4:10
Points:
- Jabez was branded from birth with a name that meant pain.
- Instead of living under that painful identity, he asked God to bless him and keep him from harm.
- His prayer reflected an honorable heart seeking God's grace rather than self-seeking ambition.
- God heard his cry and granted his request, breaking the power of the label he was given.
- Believers can reject hurtful labels from their past and embrace their true identity in God.
